title: Remote intervention
definition: Discrete commands issued from outside the vehicle that change its behaviour, such as requesting a minimal risk manoeuvre, confirming or releasing a manoeuvre, rerouting, resuming the trip or controlling doors, while the automated driving system continues to perform the DDT. EU type-approval law defines the remote intervention operator as a person outside the fully automated vehicle who may remotely achieve the tasks of the on-board operator where it is safe to do so and who shall not drive the vehicle; French and Croatian law create equivalent roles. In the Observatory a takeover of the DDT is never intervention: it is remote driving, and commands given from inside the vehicle are not remote.
